title: Al Jazeera Learning Arabic — Deferred Immersion Course
position_in_path: optional later immersion after a strong free/open MSA foundation

activation_gate.checkpoint_goal: Learner can follow simple fully-Arabic instructions/dialogues without constant English translation and has at least a stable A2-like foundation.

reason_deferred: The source uses a strict Arabic-first approach, and some previously saved media was missing/unavailable. Keep it separate from the active beginner curriculum.

media_policy.on_activation: Re-search and verify every individual Al Jazeera media item before presenting it.
media_policy.fallback: If media remains unavailable, use another verified graded Arabic-first MSA source for the same immersion role.

planned_concept_clusters: greetings and introductions in Arabic-only context
name, nationality, profession and personal information
longer multi-speaker listening and media-language transition
spaced_reinforcement_role: Optional later re-presentation of already learned concepts through Arabic-only input.
